Hi Laura / Marissa —

Quick ask: we have a high-priority AE candidate (Emily Chen, currently at Aperture Analytics via recruiter Hannah Pierce) who came in above our target comp band. Emily closed a recent multi-quarter POC with measurable ROI and would accelerate our Aperture expansion quickly. The recruiting team flagged this as a "must-win" close for Nov/Dec.

To get her on board, I’m requesting two things:
- Temporarily reassign one open AE headcount (Region: NAM) from the general hire queue to my team (this is a seat we can spare from a lagging territory).
- Approve a one-time comp-band exception for base + sign-on to land the candidate. Proposed: base $135k (band target $115–125k), sign-on $30k, OTE unchanged.

Why this matters:
- Aperture is a net-new logo for us with strong product fit and a projected $1.2M ARR in 12 months with Emily owning the relationship.
- Timeline: Emily needs an offer this week to avoid counter-offers.

Attached: candidate scorecard + proposed offer worksheet.

Ask: Can we get provisional headcount reassignment + comp-band exception approval by EOD today so I can extend? If you want, I can hop on a 15-min call to walk through the details.

Thanks —
Rishi

Rishi —

Thanks for the summary and attachments. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I green-light anything:

1) Headcount impact: which specific seat are you taking (team/IC manager + territory)? We need to log the move against a headcount pool.
2) Comp justification: do you have comp data (benchmarks or comp comps) showing Emily’s current comp vs market for analogous hires?
3) Ramp plan and forecast: the projected $1.2M ARR looks compelling — can you attach a 6-month milestone plan (bookings & measurable checkpoints) to the Drive link?

If we can get the above, I can provisionally approve a one-time band exception for base up to $135k plus an individual sign-on, contingent on Finance approval of the sign-on spend. Marissa — can you start a headcount reallocation request in Workday and flag it as "provisional pending exec approval"?

I’m free after 3pm PT for a quick sync.
